en.wizIntroSub: Our creator club: real products delivered, a clear brief, and a fee or commission for your work. Two minutes of questions and we get back to you.
en.wizNameSub: The name on your channel. No ID required.
en.wizEmailSub: No spam. We only write when there’s something worth it.
en.wizMarketSub: Missions and currency follow the market. You can be in both, but pick one home.
en.wizLinksSub: At least one link. More is always better. (Yes, we’ll peek.)
en.wizPlatformSub: The channel where most of your audience lives. That’s where we look first.
en.wizAudienceSub: A round number is fine. We’ll verify together later.
en.wizEngagementQ: How much does your audience engage?
en.wizEngagementSub: Likes and comments relative to followers, roughly. Not sure? Totally fine.
en.wizEng4: Over 5%. My audience is on fire.
en.wizNicheQ: What’s your content about, in one sentence?
en.wizNicheSub: Food, fitness, parenting, lazy recipes. Whatever’s true for you.
en.wizNichePh: e.g. quick recipes for a busy family
en.wizFitQ: How much good food makes it into your content?
en.wizFitSub: SimpliiGood is frozen spirulina, recipes and healthy living. No pretending, it always shows.
en.wizDealQ: How would you like to work with us?
en.wizDealSub: You can change your mind later. Really.
en.wizDealFeeD: A fixed fee per piece, by brief.
en.wizDealAffD: Products at home + commission on sales with your own code. No cash, no pressure.
en.wizDealEitherD: Make an offer, we’ll decide together.
en.wizConsentSub: This is how it looks from our side. All good?
en.wizDoneTitle: Got it. Welcome to the club (almost).
en.wizDoneSub: We’ll review your profile and get back to you within a few days. Meanwhile, keep doing what you do.
en.wizErrName: We need a name, even a short one.
en.wizErrLinks: At least one link, starting with https.
en.wizErrAudience: A follower count, please. Whole number.
en.wizErrNiche: A few words about the content, please.
en.ldEyebrow: The SimpliiGood Creator Club · Israel ✕ USA
en.ldH1b: Let’s make something good of it.
en.ldSub: Fresh-frozen spirulina delivered to your door, a clear brief written up front, and a fee or commission for every piece that goes live. Your voice. Your pace.
en.ldTrust: No cost. No commitment. No script.
en.ldMockMission: Reel: a morning with one spirulina cube
en.ldMockStatus: Products on their way to you
en.ldStat1: Total commission on the ambassador track. Half for you, half off for your audience.
en.ldStat2: Cost to join. Products for your content are on us.
en.ldStat3: Markets, Israel and the US, each in its own currency.
en.ldStat4: Real person approves every piece before it goes out. Not an algorithm.
en.ldStep1: Ten short questions instead of a form. Two minutes, and we already know how to work with you.
en.ldStep2t: Get the package and the brief
en.ldStep2: The products arrive at your door. The brief says exactly what’s in and what’s out. Everything else? Your voice.
en.ldStep3: After approval and publication, your fee or commission is recorded and paid. No chasing anyone.
en.ldTracksTitle: Choose how you work. You can change later.
en.ldFeeDesc: A fixed fee per piece, from a transparent rate card agreed in writing before you start.
en.ldFee3: Paid once the publication is approved
en.ldAffDesc: Products at home and a personal code for your audience. On every sale, 10% to you and 10% off for your followers. Everyone wins, nobody pushes.
en.ldTracksNote: Not sure? Pick “either” in the questionnaire and we’ll decide together.
en.ldProdText: Spirulina grown in Israel and frozen fresh, in cubes. One cube in a smoothie, soup or pasta, and that’s it. Real food that also looks good on camera.
en.ldNotEyebrow: What we won’t ask of you
en.ldNot1: No medical claims or promised results.
en.ldNot3: We’ll never ask you to buy anything.
en.ldQ1: How many followers do I need?
en.ldA1: There’s no magic number. A small audience that responds is worth more to us than a big one that scrolls. The ambassador track was built exactly for that.
en.ldA2: By brief and rate card, in writing, before you start. On the ambassador track: 10% of every sale made with your code.
en.ldA3: After the content is approved and published. Everything is recorded in the club, and you can see the status at any moment.
en.ldQ4: Do I need to buy anything?
en.ldA4: No. Products for your content are always on us.
en.ldQ5: What if it’s not for me?
en.ldA5: Decline an offer with one tap, no explanations needed. The questionnaire commits you to nothing.
en.ldFinalTitle: Ready? It takes less time than making a smoothie.
en.ldFinalSub: Ten questions. No form. And we get back to you within a few days.
en.ldFooterPrivacy: Your details are used only for the club. No mailing lists.
